notes.before_source: Measured on this branch before density tokens. Host document scroll was 0 on every screen. Overflow is .jrn-screen scrollHeight minus clientHeight.
notes.scroll_states: validation_error and email_in_use add an error panel on a full form. Scroll stays inside .jrn-screen. The host page does not scroll.
notes.scale: No transform:scale on .jrn. No overflow:hidden used to clip a too-tall root.
notes.error_states: validation_error and email_in_use use a mobile-only :has(.jrn-error) density pass so the extra panel fits 393x852. Default create is unchanged (primary at y=692).
notes.modals: Centered dialogs use a cancel button rather than an icon close. All measured dialogs stay inside the viewport and are not full-page.

states.note: Fits after error-state density. Primary CTA visible. Host scroll 0.
